TRAFFIC ADVISORY
Day 12, Wednesday 8th October, 2025
Provision of Engineering Infrastucture to Outstanding Layouts within Guzape A09 Lots and I district and AlT
Neighborhood in Asokoro A04 District

FCT motorists are hereby informed that traffic along the Guzape area by SARS, towards the NNPC Filling Station, will be slightly affected as dignitaries will be heading towards the Sir Steve Nwadiuko Street, in Guzape.

Traffic and security personnel will be deployed accordingly by 0800hrs to ensure seamless traffic flow.
Your cooperation is still highly solicited.

- Head Traffic DRTS.
